Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
-- Added by Kishore on 03/29/2012. IM 7967
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002, 50003, 50004, -- invalid date
 50011, 50012, 50021, 50023, 50025, 50026, 0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK), 1, 2)) = 'FX' then
 disp_format_mask := substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask := get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022', disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017, 50018, 50019, 50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error('5016');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;
-- End of change

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 lv_status VARCHAR2(2000);
 t_pp_id VARCHAR2(4);
 ld_sysdate DATE;
 ld_gmt_after_time DATE;
begin
 nullchk;
 if :last.choice not in ('Y','N') then
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('1057');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :last.choice = 'Y' then
 
 :system.message_level := '10';
 COMMIT; -- user can change selection flag on screen.
 :system.message_level := '0';
 
 -- Generates the extract ID and links it with the session ID in the backend.
 CNFREXTR.COMMIT_PROC(session_id_in => :ctrl_blk.session_id, extract_id_out => :ctrl_blk.extract_id, status_out => lv_status);
 
 
 if lv_status <> 'OK' then
 show_error('0600',lv_status);
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 
 ld_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 IF NVL(:last.after_time, (ld_sysdate - 1)) > ld_sysdate THEN
 ld_gmt_after_time := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, :last.after_time);

 INSERT INTO cnf_schedule_extract
 (extract_id, extract_date_time, file_name, status, chapter_id, gen_report, report_id, program_id, insert_date, insert_user)
 VALUES
 (:ctrl_blk.extract_id, ld_gmt_after_time, NULL, NULL, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :last.rsm_auto_report, NULL, :banner.prog_name, SYSDATE, :banner.user_id);
 
 
 :system.message_level := '10';
 COMMIT; 
 :system.message_level := '0';
 
 -- gen report temp table and populate rpt tables with report jobs.
 if nvl(:last.rsm_auto_report, 'N') = 'Y' then
 --MESSAGE('ext id ' || :ctrl_blk.extract_id);pause;
 
 check_testing_facility;
 
 cnfrextr.gen_series_report ( extract_id_in => :ctrl_blk.extract_id, 
 user_in => :banner.user_id,
 chp_in => :global.chapter_id,
 start_time_in => ld_gmt_after_time,
 status_out => lv_status
 );
 if lv_status <> 'OK' then
 show_error('0600',lv_status);
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 
 end if; 
 

 if nvl(:last.rsm_auto_report, 'N') = 'Y' then
 show_error('0604', ' Extract ID:' || :ctrl_blk.extract_id);
 else
 show_error('0605', ' Extract ID:' || :ctrl_blk.extract_id);
 end if;
 ELSE

 -- generates log file and results file. Updates extract date in utrs and cnf_confirm_units table.
 cnprextr.main_program(:ctrl_blk.extract_id,
 :global.chapter_id,
 :banner.user_id, -- V04
 lv_status);
 
 if lv_status <> 'OK' then
 show_error('0600',lv_status);
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 
 -- gen report temp table and populate rpt tables with report jobs.
 if nvl(:last.rsm_auto_report, 'N') = 'Y' then
 --MESSAGE('ext id ' || :ctrl_blk.extract_id);pause;

 check_testing_facility;
 
 cnfrextr.gen_series_report ( extract_id_in => :ctrl_blk.extract_id, 
 user_in => :banner.user_id,
 chp_in => :global.chapter_id,
 start_time_in => null,
 status_out => lv_status
 );
 if lv_status <> 'OK' then
 show_error('0600',lv_status);
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 
 end if; 
 
 if nvl(:last.rsm_auto_report, 'N') = 'Y' then
 show_error('0601', ' Extract ID:' || :ctrl_blk.extract_id);
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('0602', ' Extract ID:' || :ctrl_blk.extract_id);
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 END IF;
 
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_TESTING_FACILITY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_testing_facility IS
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 nCnt NUMBER;
BEGIN
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 select count(*)
 into nCnt
 from valid_testing_labs
 where testing_lab_id = :global.chapter_id
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, chp_sysdate + 10);


 if nCnt = 0 then
 show_error('1417');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
END;

END;

 end if;
 END;
